title: Slab Allocation
description: Pre-carves memory into slabs of fixed-size objects, so allocating is just popping a free slot - no searching, no splitting. Slabs eliminate fragmentation for fixed-size objects and make allocation nearly free.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Size-Class Tuning
description: Groups allocation sizes into classes and tunes the class boundaries to the program's actual size histogram. Well-tuned classes minimize internal waste while keeping the number of classes small enough for fast lookup.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Thread-Local Caches
description: Gives each thread its own small cache of free blocks so the common allocate/free path needs no locks. Thread-local caching removes allocator contention, which is often the top scalability bottleneck in multithreaded programs.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Fragmentation Metrics
description: Measures fragmentation continuously - the gap between memory held and memory usable - so tuning decisions rest on data. Without metrics, fragmentation is invisible until the allocator mysteriously fails despite apparent free space.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Adaptive Thresholds
description: Adjusts internal thresholds - when to return memory to the OS, when to trigger compaction - based on observed pressure rather than fixed constants. Adaptive thresholds keep the allocator responsive across wildly different workloads.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Huge-Page Support
description: Backs large allocations with huge pages to cut TLB misses, since one TLB entry then covers megabytes instead of kilobytes. Huge pages measurably speed up memory-heavy workloads like databases and scientific computing.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: NUMA Awareness
description: Allocates memory on the NUMA node local to the requesting thread, avoiding slow cross-node accesses. On multi-socket servers, NUMA awareness is often the difference between linear scaling and mysterious slowdowns.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Allocation Profiling
description: Records where allocations come from and how long they live, attributing memory use to code locations. Profiles turn 'we use too much memory' into 'this call site holds 40% of it', which is actionable.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Leak Detection
description: Tracks allocations never freed and reports their origin stacks at exit or on demand. Integrated leak detection catches slow leaks in testing instead of letting them become 3 AM production pages.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Pressure Callbacks
description: Notifies the application when memory pressure rises so it can shed caches before the OS starts killing processes. Cooperative pressure handling keeps services alive through spikes that would otherwise trigger the OOM killer.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Compaction
description: Moves live objects together to reclaim contiguous free regions, fighting the fragmentation that long-lived processes accumulate. Compaction needs object relocation support, but where available it restores allocator efficiency dramatically.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Guard Pages
description: Places inaccessible pages around allocations so buffer overflows crash immediately at the offending instruction instead of corrupting neighbors silently. Guard pages turn subtle heap corruption into instant, debuggable failures.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Quarantine Lists
description: Holds freed blocks in quarantine instead of reusing them immediately, so use-after-free bugs crash deterministically rather than corrupting new allocations. Quarantine is a premier debugging and hardening tool.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Latency Budgets
description: Guarantees allocation latency bounds for real-time paths by pre-allocating pools and avoiding syscalls on the hot path. Budgets make the allocator's worst case predictable, which real-time systems require.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Allocator Benchmarks
description: Measures throughput, latency distribution, and fragmentation across representative workloads so allocator choices rest on numbers. Benchmarks prevent regressions: a tuning change must prove itself faster before it ships.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.
